reasoning: Shows the universally recognized Wi-Fi symbol (a dot with two concentric radiating arcs). It is the clearest icon for tasks about home internet service, wireless networks, routers, hotspots, and ISP accounts, though it can be confused with specific Wi-Fi signal-strength variants.

pass1.ambiguity: Closely resembles a 3-arc Wi-Fi strength indicator (medium signal) or an RSS feed symbol if tilted.
